supersedes: all pre-V3 postfill state and action contracts

official_exchange_sources.title: Order directions
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: bid is YES and ask is NO; selling YES is economically buying NO; buying YES reduces a held NO position

official_exchange_sources.title: Create Order V2
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: fill_or_kill, reduce_only, and self_trade_prevention_type are supported; reduce_only caps the order by current position; self-cross prevention is a backstop and does not replace the no-self-cross gate

latency_scenario.limitation: The ten observations are a small engineering sample.  The sealed 60ms value is a conservative replay scenario, not a measured p99 and not a production latency SLA.

data_boundary.receipt_clock: strict local receive wall and monotonic clocks

decision_state.remaining_inventory_rule: Historical private partial maker fills are not identified.  Every nonterminal at-risk grid therefore requires remaining_inventory_fp = requested_qty_fp = first_fill_qty_fp.  Any decrease is unsupported DATA_INVALID, not a smaller continuing state.

nullable_feature_contract.two_sided_missing_rule: When two_sided_touch_available is false, every field in two_sided_touch_nullable_fields is NULL.  When true, all are non-NULL.
nullable_feature_contract.complement_missing_rule: complement_touch_distance_e4 is NULL if and only if complement_touch_available is false.
nullable_feature_contract.kernel_missing_rule: When kernel_fair_available is false, all seven kernel fields are NULL.  When true, all seven are non-NULL, kernel_causality_kind is SOURCE_TIME_MINUS_5000MS, and kernel_source_time_ms is no later than decision wall time minus 5000ms.
nullable_feature_contract.kernel_live_clock_rule: Any future live feature must use the same five-second delayed source-time boundary.
nullable_feature_contract.learner_imputation_boundary: Only the twelve numeric fields listed above may receive train-fold-only median imputation, paired with the three sealed availability indicators.  Kernel source time and causality kind remain audit-only.  Every other model feature remains fail-closed non-null.

canonical_v2_mapping.held_YES: ASK: sell YES; walk YES bids from best to worse
canonical_v2_mapping.held_NO: BID: buy YES to reduce NO; walk YES asks from best to worse, derived as 10000 minus NO bids

price_and_limit.full_visible_clip: freeze the decision-time canonical walk and set the limit to the worst full-clip level plus one adverse legal tick, capped at the legal boundary
price_and_limit.incomplete_visible_clip: set the limit to the most adverse legal boundary and set flatten_limit_fallback=true
price_and_limit.empty_book: empty slices, executable quantity zero, full residual inventory, and adverse-boundary fallback

execution_protocol.self_cross_failure: If no-self-cross cannot be proven when the FOK would be sent, classify SELF_CROSS_UNIDENTIFIED and roll back the complete market-day; do not emit a normal action outcome.

CANCEL_RACE_PAIR.definition: The exact private resting complement fill occurs strictly after the decision and strictly before cancel ACK.
CANCEL_RACE_PAIR.quantity_rule: complement_fill_qty equals all remaining inventory and residual inventory is zero
CANCEL_RACE_PAIR.partial_private_fill_rule: Any identified partial maker fill is unsupported DATA_INVALID and cannot be relabeled as a pair.
CANCEL_RACE_PAIR.reward_exact_requires: exact private complement price, quantity, stable receipt id, and maker fee receipt

FOK_FULL.definition: The canonical FOK fills the complete remaining clip at the frozen limit after cancel ACK and no-self-cross proof.

terminal_interval.reward: one exact observed old-policy terminal reward

keep_transition.final_60000ms_boundary: If still at risk, the 60000ms KEEP action continues only to the frozen observed old-policy terminal/hard-fallback receipt.  This is not a fabricated next grid.  Reward and capital are booked exactly once.
keep_transition.current_policy_comparator: CURRENT_DIST2_TTL60 must replay the exact historical policy receipt separately; it is not a grid-snap approximation.

first_fill_fee_conservation.FOK_FULL: maker_fee_usd equals first_fill_fee_usd; the FOK fee remains in the separate taker fee band
first_fill_fee_conservation.FOK_ZERO: maker_fee_usd equals first_fill_fee_usd; conservative lower bound additionally loses first-leg cost basis
first_fill_fee_conservation.CANCEL_RACE_PAIR: maker_fee_usd equals first_fill_fee_usd plus the exact private complement maker fee
first_fill_fee_conservation.KEEP_COMPLEMENT_FILL: maker_fee_usd equals first_fill_fee_usd plus the exact private complement maker fee
first_fill_fee_conservation.KEEP_ADMIN_OR_HARD_FALLBACK: terminal receipt separately states first_fill_fee_usd and exit fee; their sum must equal the serialized total fee

economics.fee_precision_limitation: Public L2 price levels do not identify the private fill partition.  FOK_FULL is therefore a low/base/high fee sensitivity band, not an exact fee claim.

historical_private_feed_limitation.reporting_requirement: Every result must state that historical private partial maker fills were not identified by the public strict-trade-through proxy.  If a source does identify a partial private fill, roll back the market-day as unsupported DATA_INVALID.
historical_private_feed_limitation.forward_requirement: A future private-feed forward test must validate partial-fill and cancel-race handling independently.

fail_closed_gates: full expected episode roster by market-day
one KEEP and one FLATTEN_FOK row per causal state
one FLATTEN_FOK outcome and one KEEP transition per state
at-risk inventory equals the complete first-fill quantity
no stale touch or midpoint carry
no self-cross uncertainty at FOK send
